topic: Machine Learning for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health Estimation and Remaining-Useful-Life Prediction

judge.rationale: The paper proposes a general prognostic framework evaluated on battery data (XJTU) among other domains, but its main contribution is a domain-agnostic physics-informed neural network rather than a focused study on lithium-ion battery state-of-health estimation or remaining-useful-life prediction.

The paper directly addresses data-driven state-of-health estimation and remaining-useful-life prediction for lithium-ion batteries using Gaussian process regression, which is a core method within the survey's scope.
The paper explicitly addresses state-of-health estimation and remaining-useful-life prediction for lithium-ion batteries using machine learning, which are the core topics of the survey.
The paper directly addresses lithium-ion battery state-of-health estimation using a machine learning method (support vector regression), which is a core topic of the survey.
